correctness.rationale: For n>=3 labelled simple cycles and synchronous integer sign-gradient update, express edges as e_i=x_{i+1}-x_i, signs s_i and next-step signs t_i. Period at most two forces s_i+t_i a constant; zero sum of differences forces zero, hence reverses every nonzero sign. The local equation e_i^new=e_i+s_{i-1}-2s_i+s_{i+1} makes q=|e_i| range from 1 to 1-s_i(s_{i-1}+s_{i+1}) for nonzero edges; for zero edges forces adjacent signs sum zero. The 9-pair-state Laurent matrix exactly enumerates choices; coefficient z^0 imposes global zero winding and produces one translation class per closed edge word. Only constant fixed class exists, and the rest pair into distinct two-cycles by conserved total chip sum. Explicit cycles give sharp edge gap three n>=4 and two n=3. Independent direct sign-update enumerations n=3..6 matched coefficients 19,47,171,517; all-n proof is analytic transfer bijection, while eventual period<=2 relies on Long–Narayanan.
